text:
Alex (sales): Hey team — running a POC with ACME; they're blocked on a few things before exec sign-off. Can we triage?
Jin (solutions): TL;DR: model they pinned (redwood-gpt-13b-v2) isn't available in eu-west-1 and customer needs VPC + KMS. Also asking about Dedicated pricing for reserved throughput.
Mike (ACME): Confirming — we need model pinned to avoid drift. Our infra is in eu-west-1; we tried the pinned model and got an error.
Tara (eng-oncall): Can you paste the request + error?
Mike (ACME): Here's the curl we ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-13b-v2","input":"hello"}'
```
We get: `{"error":"MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REGION","code":403}`
Jin (solutions): Yep that's the region-model gap. We currently don't have that variant on Dedicated infra in eu-west-1; hosted fallback works in us-west-2 only.
Alex (sales): Customer is enterprise — won't accept cross-region data flow. They require keys in their KMS and VPC egress controls.
Andrew (security): Two questions: 1) Can they BYOK/HSM? 2) What logs/audit guarantees for Private?
Eva (legal): Also they asked for standard SCC + encryption at rest details for contract.
Tara (eng-oncall): For BYOK: Private deployment supports KMS integration (customer-managed). For Hosted we offer envelope encryption but not BYOK unless Private.
Jin (solutions): Mitigation options: 1) Offer Dedicated instance in eu-west-1 with compatible model build (needs ~3 days to provision + model residency sync). 2) Suggest supported model variant that is available in region (redwood-gpt-13b-quant) — requires acceptance for quantization quality tradeoffs.
Mike (ACME): How different is the quantized variant? Will prompts + evals break?
Jin (solutions): Usually negligible on our eval sets for short-form generation, but we'll run their eval suite — need sample prompts.
Alex (sales): Pricing question from Mike: what's the uplift for Dedicated reserved vs hosted pay-as-you-go for sustained 100 req/s?
Jin (solutions): Rough calc: Dedicated reserved w/ 4x A100 equiv — approximate committed monthly $XXk, typically 40-60% cheaper per token at that load. I'll DM exact numbers.
Andrew (security): For compliance: confirm Private + VPC will include audit logs, KMS integration, and optional HSM for keys — legal/engineering to specify SLA.
Eva (legal): I'll start an SCC addendum draft and attach required certs. Mike, what compliance regime do you need (SOC2, ISO27001, FedRAMP)?
Mike (ACME): SOC2 + ISO27001. Also mandatory: key custody by their security team.
Tara (eng-oncall): Ok for SOC2/ISO — Private + Dedicated path supports that. For key custody we need Private with KMS/HSM. Note: that'll push timeline ~2–3 weeks for deployment and security review.
Jin (solutions): Action items: 1) Jin to run eval on ACME prompt set against quant variant (ETA 48h). 2) Tara to confirm provisioning timeline for Dedicated in eu-west-1 (ETA 72h). 3) Eva to kick SCC + KMS wording. 4) Alex to share pricing delta.
Alex (sales): Noted. Mike — we'll loop you with timelines and a formal runbook. Any blockers from your side?
Mike (ACME): We'll send prompts + security questionnaire today. Also can you surface the exact error logs we saw? We want to include them in our internal ticket.
Tara (eng-oncall): The platform logs showed this in the control plane: `region_check: failed model redwood-gpt-13b-v2 not found in region eu-west-1; fallback=false` and on the API proxy: `403 MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REGION`.
deploy-bot: Notice: provisioning job #245 queued for eu-west-1 dedicated cluster (requires manual approval).
Jin (solutions): If legal approves BYOK path, provisioning moves faster. Otherwise we can propose a temporary acceptance of quant variant on Dedicated to unblock demo.
Eva (legal): I'll prioritize the BYOK/KMS clause. If they insist on HSM, need CS/infra sign-off.
Alex (sales): Great. I'll coordinate with Mike for the questionnaire and push for the prompt set. Thanks all — will update thread when we have eval results. :thumbsup:
